subject: Unusual RTT inflation affecting Helio Health — mitigation & timeline
messages:
From: Lucy Hart <lucy.hart@heliohealth.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Mar 2028 08:17:00 +0000
Subject: Sudden p95/p99 latency spike — Helio production (EU)

Hi Evelyn / Irene,

We're seeing a significant jump in API latency for our EU traffic since ~07:45 UTC this morning. p95 went from ~120ms to 520ms, and p99 is above 1s. Error rate (5xx) briefly spiked to 0.9%. This is impacting live clinical workflows.

We capture a few request IDs and sample traces in the attached helioreq-traces.zip. Can someone please confirm what changed and provide an ETA for mitigation?

We've already rerouted a small subset of traffic to our fallback but the app still reports timeouts. This is urgent — please escalate.

Thanks,
Lucy
Director of Platform Reliability
Helio Health

Attachments: helioreq-traces.zip (traces + tcpdumps)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Hart <lucy.hart@heliohealth.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Mar 2028 08:29:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 latency spike — Helio production (EU)

Hi Lucy — sorry to hear this. We're on it.

Irene (AM), I'm looping you and Marcus from Eng. Vivek (SRE) is on call and will look at routing and edge telemetry now. We'll pull relevant traces and follow up within 30 minutes.

--
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Mar 2028 08:34:00 +0000
Subject: Investigate: EU->US pathing for Helio traffic (possible smart-routing fallback)

Team —

Summary: Helio (eu-central) traffic appears to have been routed to US region egress (us-west) intermittently this morning, causing RTT inflation and the p95/p99 jumps they reported. Evelyn attached traces show RUM spans landing in us-west with ~300-500ms extra RTT.

Immediate asks:
- Vivek: please validate whether the smart-routing layer or the new geo-fallback-v2 policy pushed last night caused unintended route selection for eu-origin traffic.
- Marcus: be ready to approve a config rollback or targeted override for Helio.
- Marissa / Evelyn: please hold customer comms to brief update with timeline and mitigation plan.

Attachments referenced in the thread (from Helio): helioreq-traces.zip. I pulled a quick summary and attached a short runbook snippet in case we need fast rollback.

Irene
VP, Sales (covering Helio)
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Mar 2028 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Investigate: EU->US pathing for Helio traffic (possible smart-routing fallback)

Checked edge telemetry + routing control plane. Findings so far:
- Starting 07:42 UTC there's a cluster of EU-origin requests that were routed to us-west egress.
- The routing decision table shows that the policy "geo-fallback-v2" was evaluated and a fallback path to us-west was selected when the primary eu pool reported transient capacity flags.
- There was a recent rollout (2028-03-19 22:10 UTC) that altered a threshold in geo-fallback-v2 (reduced min healthy instances) — the threshold change made early cutover to fallback more aggressive under short blips.

Proposed immediate mitigations:
1) Hot rollback of the geo-fallback-v2 threshold change (revert to previous config). Will take ~10-15m to propagate.
2) Create a temporary per-customer route override (pin Helio traffic to eu-central pool) while we validate rollback. This is non-disruptive and reversible.

I will start step 1 now and open a change with a 15-minute rollback window.

Logs and query ids: console link: https://console.redwood.ai/s/viz/trace/abcd-1234 (internal).

-Vivek
Senior SRE

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Mar 2028 08:52:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Investigate: EU->US pathing for Helio traffic (possible smart-routing fallback)

Thanks Vivek — please proceed with rollback and the per-customer override.

Action plan (immediate):
1) Vivek: rollback geo-fallback-v2 threshold (ETA 15m).
2) Vivek/Oncall: apply route override to pin Helio to eu-central (ETA 10m after rollback result).
3) Marcus/Irene: prepare customer comms and credit proposal.
4) Post-mitigation: root cause RCA to include why threshold change ended up too aggressive + test coverage to prevent recurrence.

I will monitor and be available to approve emergency change if needed. Attaching mitigation_steps.md and runbook-snippet.txt for the team.

-Marcus
Head of Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Hart <lucy.hart@heliohealth.com>
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Mar 2028 09:25:00 +0000
Subject: Redwood incident update & proposed immediate remediation (Helio)

Hi Lucy — following up with the mitigation steps we just executed:
- We rolled back the geo-fallback-v2 threshold and applied a temporary route override that pins Helio traffic to eu-central. Early telemetry shows p95 back to ~140-160ms and error rate returning to baseline.

We recognize this disruption impacted your production workflows — as a gesture we'll propose a credit against March usage and offer a 72-hour complimentary burst capacity if you want us to re-run workloads while we finish the RCA.

Next steps:
- We'll share an RCA draft by EOD tomorrow (Mar 21).
- Weekly follow-ups until RCA is closed.
- Once RCA is done we'll propose configuration guardrails and a test plan to avoid the aggressive fallback behavior.

Would you like the credit details in writing and a brief exec call?

Apologies again and thanks for the patience.

—Marissa Cole
Customer Escalations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: route-override-request.pdf

From: Lucy Hart <lucy.hart@heliohealth.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood incident update & proposed immediate remediation (Helio)

Thanks Marissa, Evelyn and team — appreciate the quick turnaround and the temporary fix. p95 is back to normal for now.

We'd like the credit details and the 72-hour burst offer in writing. Also please schedule a 30-minute exec-level sync for early next week to review RCA and the proposed guardrails — invite: Lucy + Platform Eng lead + Product.

Please confirm the timeline for the public RCA draft and who from Redwood will present.

Best,
Lucy
Director of Platform Reliability, Helio Health
